observations.behavior: Adds GROWTH_SIGNUP_ENRICHMENT_ENABLED and GROWTH_ICP_REENRICH_DAILY_CAP to the list of settings allowing API override.
observations.code_quote: "Kill switch for signup enrichment (products/growth/backend/enrichment): dispatch at signup, the daily re-enrichment sweep, and the recovery backfill. Every pod reads this row, so it is the one per-region toggle.",
observations.posthog_connection: These settings control the daily ICP re-enrichment sweep, which fetches organizations from Harmonic. The kill switch allows operators to disable this workflow without changing database state.

observations.behavior: Removes the definition of GROWTH_SIGNUP_ENRICHMENT_ENABLED and GROWTH_ICP_REENRICH_DAILY_CAP from web.py, moving them to dynamic_settings.py.

observations.posthog_connection: This change moves the configuration of the ICP re-enrichment sweep from a per-request setting to a shared, database-backed setting, allowing all pods to read the same value.

observations.posthog_connection: Provides a database-backed, cache-miss-safe, exception-handling read of the GROWTH_SIGNUP_ENRICHMENT_ENABLED instance setting, allowing the workflow to continue even if the DB read fails. This supports the documented requirement that signup enrichment must never stall or fail on a database read, and it replaces the previous direct settings access with a safer, database-backed path.
